## Architecture Compliance Checklist
- [ ] Clean Architecture: Separation of Concerns (SoC) and SRP respected.
- [ ] Code Purity: No inline or explanatory comments within the code.
- [ ] File Size: No modified or added files exceed 500 lines.
- [ ] Security: Zero-Trust input validation and OWASP sanitization verified.
- [ ] Error Handling: Global exception handling used; no silenced exceptions.
- [ ] Colocation: Files grouped by functional bounded context.
